ai_preservation_rule: Zero AI modules or capabilities removed. Unreachable AI assets are assigned to Phase 2B AI Studio Hub re-homing.

items.title: Eliminate Dual Catalog Split-Brain (Single Canonical catalog in profile.json)
items.root_cause: WhatsAppView Catálogo writes directly to /api/whatsapp/api/skus/adicionar (skus.json) without updating profile.json, leaving StoreV5Pane and DashboardView out of sync (verified in TC-07: skusJsonCount=1, profileCatalogCount=0).
items.remediation: Route WhatsApp catalog edits through PUT /api/profile (or server-side write-through to profile.json + bot projection) so Storefront, Dashboard, and WhatsApp share revision-locked catalog state.
items.ai_impact: Enhances reliability for AI store compiler and AI photo acquisition.

items.title: Replace 4 Contradictory WhatsApp Booleans with Single ConnectionState Enum
items.root_cause: whatsapp.conectado, browserWhatsapp.connected, storePhoneReady, and onboardingConcluido drift across Dual View, Sidebar, StoreV5Pane banner, and WhatsAppView (verified in TC-08: 'Abra para detectar' shown next to 'Conectado').
items.remediation: Compute single server-authoritative ConnectionState enum rendered identically across Topbar, Sidebar, Storefront publish gate, and Attendance pillar.

items.title: Switch App.tsx handleSaveFichaAndGenerate to updateBusinessProfile() 409 Retry
items.root_cause: App.tsx:241 invokes raw saveBusinessProfile() lacking the 4x 409 optimistic retry present in profile-service.ts updateBusinessProfile().
items.remediation: Consolidate profile saves on updateBusinessProfile() with field-level conflict merge.

items.title: Unify Green/Blue Token Split-Brain, Fix Dark Mode Contrast, Enforce >=44px Controls & >=14px Text
items.root_cause: TC-05 shows white-on-white header text in StoreV5Pane dark mode; TC-09/TC-12 show 15/15 and 20/22 visible controls below 44px and dominant 11-12px fonts.
items.remediation: Adopt unified Slate (#F8FAFC) / White (#FFFFFF) / Ink (#0F172A) / Cobalt (#2563EB) tokens across Variant A or B, with full dark-mode token coverage.

items.title: Consolidate 4-Pillar Navigation + Keep Business Profile Accessible + Remove Orphan 'connect' & Dual Dead-End
items.root_cause: Sidebar hides Ficha & Produtos after onboarding (TC-10: count=0); App.tsx renders nothing for activeMenu==='connect'; Dual View strands users on 'Os dois navegadores foram recolhidos'.
items.remediation: Implement Variant B 4-Pillar Navigation (1. Loja & Catálogo IA, 2. Atendimento & Bot, 3. Pedidos & Painel, 4. Configurações & Conta) plus persistent drawer shortcuts.

items.title: Re-Home Unreachable AI Modules into Unified AI Studio Hub
items.root_cause: StoreCompilerView, AssetHunterView, GeneratePostsView, CalendarGrid, dynamic-synthesizer, store-prompt-generator, sofia-flow-store, Generate30DaysDialog, ExportDialog exist in src/ but are unreachable from main.tsx.
items.remediation: Mount all preserved AI tools inside the Variant B AI Studio Hub & Catalog Drawer with zero deletion of AI logic.

items.title: Replace Static 6-Section Adapter with 7 Sector Experience Signatures
items.root_cause: src/store-v5/profile-adapter.ts:240-292 ignores business segment and renders identical sections across niches.
items.remediation: Activate dynamic-synthesizer & protein-registry patterns for Pet Store, Bakery, Distributor, Pharmacy, Clinic, Hardware Store, and School.

items.title: Expose Order Management UI (PATCH /api/orders), Wire Dashboard Period Filter, Deduplicate Idle Polling
items.root_cause: PATCH /api/orders has no frontend UI; Dashboard 7/30/90 select triggers zero API requests (TC-09); dual 5s+2s polling generates ~45 req/min idle (TC-11: 6 reqs in 8s).
items.remediation: Add Orders management table (with mobile card view verified at 390px) in Pilar 3, add ?days= query param to /api/dashboard, and unify polling in a single shared context/SSE stream.
